headline: OpenAI's 1st hardware device screenless AI speaker reportedly in development
summary: OpenAI's first hardware device is a mobile smart speaker with AI capabilities that can sync with ChatGPT. It is designed to be screen-free and have a 'personality'.
details: OpenAI's first foray into hardware devices is reported to be a mobile smart speaker with integrated AI capabilities that can sync with ChatGPT and provide other home AI services. The device is still currently under development.

The device is designed to be screen-free and is being pitched internally as a 'humanlike AI companion that lives in the home.' It is said to have a 'personality' and be able to proactively learn about its owner over time, providing more personalized service.

The machine would have access to a user's digital life, drawing off things like emails. It is also described as involving 'mechanical elements that can move on their own' and is designed to 'feel like a companion and become a physical manifestation of OpenAI's ChatGPT.'

The device was developed with help from many former Apple engineers who were instrumental in 'creating products such as the iPhone and Mac.' OpenAI may be attempting to launch a new hardware line, but the company is currently up to its eyeballs in trouble over hardware-related legal problems.

OpenAI's first hardware device: a screenless AI speaker?

OpenAI's first foray into hardware devices is reported to be a mobile smart speaker with integrated AI capabilities that can sync with ChatGPT and provide other home AI services. The device is still currently under development.

The device is designed to be screen-free and is being pitched internally as a 'humanlike AI companion that lives in the home.' It is said to have a 'personality' and be able to proactively learn about its owner over time, providing more personalized service.

The machine would have access to a user's digital life, drawing off things like emails. It is also described as involving 'mechanical elements that can move on their own' and is designed to 'feel like a companion and become a physical manifestation of OpenAI's ChatGPT.'

The device was developed with help from many former Apple engineers who were instrumental in 'creating products such as the iPhone and Mac.' OpenAI may be attempting to launch a new hardware line, but the company is currently up to its eyeballs in trouble over hardware-related legal problems.
